headline: Executive order sets the order in which Treasury Department officials would step in to lead if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order lists which Treasury Department officials would act as Secretary of the Treasury if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or are otherwise unable to do the job. Orders like this are routine and help make sure the department always has someone in charge. No summary was provided, so details such as the exact list of positions are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Certain officials are named in a set order to temporarily lead the department if top leaders are unavailable.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 3, 2025; the exact effective date is not stated in the provided material.
